name: OpenAI Gym / Gymnasium (MuJoCo)
note_en: De-facto RL interface; MuJoCo locomotion tasks are the classic continuous-control benchmark.
note_zh: 事实标准的强化学习接口；其 MuJoCo 运动任务是经典连续控制评测。

name: DeepMind Control Suite
note_en: MuJoCo continuous-control tasks; standard for pixel-based RL.
note_zh: MuJoCo 连续控制任务，基于像素的强化学习的标准评测。

name: Franka Kitchen (Relay Policy Learning)
note_en: Long-horizon kitchen tasks; part of D4RL and now Gymnasium-Robotics.
note_zh: 长时序厨房任务，收录于 D4RL，现属 Gymnasium-Robotics。

name: Meta-World
note_en: Multi-task / meta-RL benchmark on MuJoCo; now maintained by Farama.
note_zh: MuJoCo 上的多任务 / 元强化学习评测，现由 Farama 维护。

name: RLBench
note_en: CoppeliaSim/PyRep engine; the 18-task PerAct subset is the standard keyframe-policy benchmark.
note_zh: 基于 CoppeliaSim/PyRep；其中 18 个任务的 PerAct 子集是关键帧策略的标准评测。

name: SoftGym
note_en: Deformable-object benchmark (rope, cloth, fluid) on NVIDIA FleX.
note_zh: 基于 NVIDIA FleX 的可变形物体评测（绳、布、液体）。

name: PlasticineLab
note_en: Differentiable soft-body (MPM) benchmark built on Taichi.
note_zh: 基于 Taichi 的可微软体（MPM）评测。

name: ManiSkill (v1)
note_en: Generalisable manipulation challenge on SAPIEN with large demos; superseded by ManiSkill2/3.
note_zh: 基于 SAPIEN、强调泛化的操作挑战，提供大规模示范；已被 ManiSkill2/3 取代。

name: ManiSkill2
note_en: ICLR 2023 benchmark incl. soft-body tasks; its repo became today's ManiSkill (v3) repo; v2 code is deprecated.
note_zh: ICLR 2023 评测，含软体任务；原仓库已演变为现在的 ManiSkill（v3），v2 代码已弃用。

name: robomimic
note_en: Offline imitation-learning study + datasets (Lift, Can, Square, Transport, Tool Hang).
note_zh: 离线模仿学习研究与数据集（Lift、Can、Square、Transport、Tool Hang）。

name: CALVIN
note_en: Long-horizon language-conditioned benchmark; ABC→D split tests environment generalisation.
note_zh: 长时序语言条件评测；ABC→D 划分考察跨环境泛化。

name: VIMA-Bench
note_en: Multimodal-prompt (text + image) tabletop manipulation.
note_zh: 多模态提示（文本加图像）的桌面操作评测。

name: ARNOLD
note_en: Language-grounded tasks with continuous object states (e.g. pour half a cup).
note_zh: 带连续物体状态的语言指令任务（如倒半杯水）。

name: LIBERO
note_en: Lifelong-learning benchmark that became the most-reported VLA sim benchmark; near-saturated (>95%) by 2025.
note_zh: 终身学习评测，后成为 VLA 最常报告的仿真基准；2025 年已接近饱和（>95%）。

name: RoboHive
robots: Franka, Adroit hand, MyoSuite musculoskeletal, quadrupeds
note_en: Unified MuJoCo framework/benchmark (NeurIPS 2023 D&B) incl. Franka Kitchen, Adroit, MyoSuite.
note_zh: 统一的 MuJoCo 框架与评测（NeurIPS 2023 D&B），含 Franka Kitchen、Adroit、MyoSuite。

name: THE COLOSSEUM
note_en: Generalisation stress-test (colour, texture, lighting, camera, distractors) on RLBench.
note_zh: 在 RLBench 上做泛化压力测试（颜色、纹理、光照、相机、干扰物）。

name: SimplerEnv
org: UC San Diego / Stanford / Google DeepMind
metric: Success rate; MMRV & Pearson vs real
note_en: Real-to-sim evaluation correlated with real RT-1/Bridge results; GPU port in ManiSkill3.
note_zh: 与真机 RT-1 / Bridge 结果相关的 real-to-sim 评测；ManiSkill3 中有 GPU 版。

name: RoboTwin (1.0)
note_en: Dual-arm benchmark with generative digital twins (CVPR 2025); also ran as CVPR 2025 MEIS challenge.
note_zh: 借助生成式数字孪生的双臂评测（CVPR 2025），也作为 CVPR 2025 MEIS 挑战赛。

name: GemBench
note_en: Hierarchical generalisation benchmark (placement, rigid, articulated, long-horizon) with 3D-LOTUS++ baseline.
note_zh: 分层泛化评测（摆放、刚体、铰接、长时序），基线为 3D-LOTUS++。

name: VLABench
note_en: Language-conditioned long-horizon tasks needing world knowledge and reasoning.
note_zh: 需要常识与推理的语言条件长时序任务。

name: RoboTwin 2.0
robots: 5 embodiments: Aloha-AgileX, ARX X5, Piper, Franka, UR5e
hw_names: COBOT Magic; PiPER; Franka Research 3; Universal Robots UR7e-920 (formerly UR5e)
note_en: Scalable data generator + benchmark with strong domain randomisation; 100k+ expert trajectories.
note_zh: 可扩展数据生成器加评测，强域随机化；10 万条以上专家轨迹。

name: RoboCerebra
note_en: Long-horizon benchmark testing System-2 planning + System-1 execution with 1,000 annotated trajectories.
note_zh: 长时序评测，考察 System-2 规划与 System-1 执行，含 1000 条标注轨迹。

name: LIBERO-Plus
note_en: Robustness analysis of VLAs (camera, robot state, language, light, background, noise, layout).
note_zh: VLA 鲁棒性分析（相机、机器人初始状态、语言、光照、背景、噪声、布局）。

name: LIBERO-PRO
note_en: Shows VLAs that score >90% on LIBERO collapse under object/state/instruction/environment changes.
note_zh: 显示在 LIBERO 上 >90% 的 VLA 在物体、状态、指令、环境变化下大幅失效。

name: RoboCasa365
note_en: Large RoboCasa task expansion released 18 Feb 2026 (date per Bifrost comparison).
note_zh: RoboCasa 的大规模任务扩展，2026 年 2 月 18 日发布（日期据 Bifrost 对比文章）。

name: Genie Sim Benchmark
note_en: Evaluation module of Genie Sim 3.0; figures are company claims.
note_zh: Genie Sim 3.0 的评测模块；数字为公司口径。

name: RoboDojo
robots: ARX X5, AgileX Piper, Piper X (real) + sim
note_en: Unified sim-and-real benchmark; best of 30 policies reached 8.8% sim / 12.8% real vs ~76% human teleop.
note_zh: 仿真与真机统一评测；30 个策略中最佳仅 8.8%（仿真）/ 12.8%（真机），人类遥操约 76%。

name: EQA (Embodied Question Answering)
note_en: Agent must navigate to answer questions; ancestor of OpenEQA.
note_zh: 智能体需导航后回答问题，OpenEQA 的前身。

name: Room-to-Room (R2R)
note_en: Founding vision-and-language navigation benchmark.
note_zh: 视觉语言导航（VLN）的开山评测。

name: Habitat Challenge
note_en: Annual CVPR embodied-AI challenge series since 2019.
note_zh: 自 2019 年起每年在 CVPR 举办的具身智能挑战赛。

name: ALFRED
note_en: Long-horizon household instruction following in AI2-THOR.
note_zh: AI2-THOR 中长时序家务指令跟随。

name: VLN-CE
note_en: Moves VLN from nav-graphs to continuous low-level control.
note_zh: 把 VLN 从导航图搬到连续底层控制。

name: BEHAVIOR-100
note_en: First BEHAVIOR release on iGibson 2.0; superseded by BEHAVIOR-1K.
note_zh: BEHAVIOR 首版，基于 iGibson 2.0；已被 BEHAVIOR-1K 取代。

name: BEHAVIOR-1K
hw_names: R1 PRO; Fetch Mobile Manipulator; TIAGo
note_en: Human-centred benchmark of 1,000 activities in 50 scenes with 9k+ objects (CoRL 2022).
note_zh: 以人为中心的 1000 项日常活动评测，50 个场景、9000 多个物体（CoRL 2022）。

name: BEHAVIOR Challenge 2025
note_en: NeurIPS 2025 challenge; winners announced Dec 2025. Paper link is the 2nd-place Openpi Comet report (Q 0.2514).
note_zh: NeurIPS 2025 挑战赛，2025 年 12 月公布结果。论文链接为第二名 Openpi Comet 的报告（Q 0.2514）。

name: HomeRobot OVMM
org: Meta AI / Hello Robot / CMU / Georgia Tech
note_en: Open-vocabulary mobile manipulation; NeurIPS 2023 challenge with real Stretch evaluation.
note_zh: 开放词汇移动操作；NeurIPS 2023 挑战赛，含真机 Stretch 评测。

name: ManiSkill-HAB
note_en: GPU-accelerated home rearrangement with low-level control (ICLR 2025).
note_zh: GPU 加速的家庭重排，底层控制（ICLR 2025）。

name: LocoMuJoCo
robots: Unitree H1, Talos, Atlas, quadrupeds, musculoskeletal
note_en: Imitation-learning benchmark for locomotion with real mocap retargeted to many humanoids.
note_zh: 运动模仿学习评测，把真人动捕重定向到多款人形。

name: HumanoidBench
note_en: Whole-body locomotion and manipulation tasks for high-DoF humanoids.
note_zh: 面向高自由度人形的全身运动与操作任务。

name: SIMPLE
note_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark reporting zero-shot sim2real and sim rankings tracking real ones.
note_zh: 人形移动操作评测，报告零样本 sim2real，仿真排名与真机一致。

name: Real Robot Challenge (TriFinger)
org: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
note_en: Remote real-robot dexterity challenge (2020-2022) on open-source TriFinger platforms.
note_zh: 基于开源 TriFinger 平台的远程真机灵巧操作挑战（2020–2022）。

name: Bi-DexHands
note_en: Bimanual dexterous RL benchmark (NeurIPS 2022 D&B).
note_zh: 双手灵巧操作强化学习评测（NeurIPS 2022 D&B）。

name: DexArt
note_en: Generalisable dexterous manipulation of articulated objects (CVPR 2023).
note_zh: 铰接物体上可泛化的灵巧操作（CVPR 2023）。

name: FurnitureBench
note_en: Reproducible real-world long-horizon assembly benchmark with 3D-printed furniture.
note_zh: 使用 3D 打印家具的可复现真机长时序装配评测。

name: RoboVQA
note_en: Long-horizon robotics video QA dataset + benchmark.
note_zh: 长时序机器人视频问答数据集与评测。

name: OpenEQA
robots: Episodic memory from ScanNet / HM3D scans
note_en: Open-vocabulary embodied QA for foundation models (CVPR 2024).
note_zh: 面向基础模型的开放词汇具身问答（CVPR 2024）。

name: RoboSpatial
note_en: Spatial-understanding dataset + benchmark for robotics VLMs (CVPR 2025).
note_zh: 面向机器人 VLM 的空间理解数据集与评测（CVPR 2025）。

name: VSI-Bench (Thinking in Space)
note_en: Visual-spatial intelligence benchmark for MLLMs.
note_zh: 多模态大模型的视觉空间智能评测。

name: PhysBench
note_en: VLM physical-world understanding (properties, relationships, scenes, dynamics); ICLR 2025.
note_zh: VLM 物理世界理解评测（属性、关系、场景、动力学），ICLR 2025。

name: EmbodiedBench
note_en: Evaluates MLLMs as vision-driven embodied agents from high-level planning to low-level control (ICML 2025).
note_zh: 评估多模态大模型作为视觉驱动具身智能体，从高层规划到底层控制（ICML 2025）。

name: ERQA
note_en: Embodied Reasoning QA released with Gemini Robotics; spatial, trajectory, state reasoning.
note_zh: 随 Gemini Robotics 发布的具身推理问答，涵盖空间、轨迹、状态推理。

name: Physics-IQ
note_en: Tests whether video generation models predict physically plausible continuations.
note_zh: 检验视频生成模型能否预测符合物理的后续画面。

name: WorldScore
note_en: Unified benchmark for 3D / 4D / video world generation.
note_zh: 3D / 4D / 视频世界生成的统一评测。

name: EWMBench
note_en: Evaluates embodied world models on scene consistency, motion correctness and semantic alignment.
note_zh: 从场景一致性、运动正确性、语义对齐评估具身世界模型。

name: LeRobot (lerobot-eval / EnvHub)
robots: SO-100/101, Koch, ALOHA, HopeJR, Reachy 2, LeKiwi + sim envs (LIBERO, Meta-World, Isaac Lab-Arena)
note_en: Open robot-learning library; lerobot-eval + EnvHub share sim benchmarks on the Hub (Isaac Lab-Arena integration Jan 2026). Hugging Face is HQ'd in the US.
note_zh: 开源机器人学习库；lerobot-eval 与 EnvHub 在 Hub 上共享仿真评测（2026 年 1 月接入 Isaac Lab-Arena）。

name: Isaac Lab-Arena
note_en: Policy-evaluation framework on Isaac Lab; date = public LeRobot integration post (Jan 2026).
note_zh: 基于 Isaac Lab 的策略评测框架；日期为公开接入 LeRobot 的博文时间（2026 年 1 月）。

name: vla-eval
note_en: Unified evaluation harness and public leaderboard for VLAs.
note_zh: VLA 的统一评测框架与公开排行榜。

name: AutoEval
note_en: Public autonomous real-robot evaluation with learned reset & success classifiers; anyone can submit policies.
note_zh: 公开的自主真机评测，使用学习到的复位与成功判别器，任何人都可提交策略。

name: RoboArena
org: UC Berkeley / Stanford / UW / UT Austin et al.
robots: DROID platform: Franka Panda + Robotiq (distributed labs)
note_en: Distributed real-world evaluation: evaluators across labs run double-blind pairwise comparisons.
note_zh: 分布式真机评测：多个实验室的评估者做双盲两两对比。

name: ManipArena
org: Sun Yat-sen University / X Square Robot / MBZUAI
zh: 中山大学 / 自变量机器人
note_en: Real-world reasoning-oriented manipulation evaluation (CVPR 2026) with 10,812 expert trajectories.
note_zh: 面向推理的真机操作评测（CVPR 2026），含 10812 条专家轨迹。

name: AgiBot World Challenge 2026
note_en: Competition moving from sim to real; 2026 Reasoning-to-Action track scores understanding, planning and execution.
note_zh: 从仿真到真机的竞赛；2026 年“推理到行动”赛道评估理解、规划与执行全过程。
